why_ai: Developers adopt tools explained by a credible person in talks and workshops, which AI cannot stand in for.
why_clarity: Advocacy impact has no agreed metric and adoption shows up months later, unattributed.
why_digital: Code and content work on screen, with conference talks and workshops delivered in person.

why_ai: Attribution is causal analysis of logged data that AI-native measurement tools can perform.
why_clarity: The field never agreed a method, and conversions arrive months after the untracked influence.
why_digital: Signup, community and CRM data in, attribution reports out.

why_ai: Aggregate cohort comparisons are standard quasi-experimental analysis that software can design and run.
why_clarity: Region, segment and before-after comparisons are known designs, with results over months.
why_digital: Aggregate adoption data in, comparison analyses out, all on screen.

why_ai: Outcome metrics like answer rates and retention can be computed directly from platform logs.
why_clarity: Answered questions and member retention are objective metrics recomputed continuously.
why_digital: Community platform logs in, dashboards out.

why_ai: Onboarding, moderation, tagging and reporting are mechanical tasks bots and LLMs already handle.
why_clarity: The same onboarding and moderation actions recur daily with clear rules.
why_digital: Runs entirely inside Discord, Slack and forum platforms.

why_ai: Repurposing a talk into posts, threads and docs is exactly what generative AI does.
why_clarity: Mechanical conversion of one asset into a fixed set of formats, repeated for every piece.
why_digital: Recordings and posts in, digital content across online surfaces out.

why_ai: Sponsorship choices rest on organiser relationships, but comparison and allocation are automatable analysis.
why_clarity: Annual decisions made by precedent, with event outcomes never measured.
why_digital: Budget analysis on screen, but the spend buys physical booths, travel and organiser relationships.

why_ai: Linking pseudonymous identities raises consent and privacy-law questions needing accountable human governance.
why_clarity: Linking accuracy is checkable, but whether the design is acceptable remains contested.
why_digital: Registration, handle and signup data linked entirely in software.

why_ai: Keeping sample apps working is continuous testing and dependency updating that AI coding agents automate.
why_clarity: A sample either runs against the current product or fails, checked instantly in CI.
why_digital: Code repositories in and out, entirely on screen.

why_ai: The product is the advocate's own portable credibility, delivered through in-person talks and presence.
why_clarity: Credibility is a matter of reputation and its effect on adoption is never measured.
why_digital: Content is digital, but travel and public performance on stage carry the value.

why_ai: A familiar person helps, but triage, routing and answer reuse are automatable support work.
why_clarity: Questions are answered or not, they recur heavily, and resolution is quickly visible.
why_digital: All questions and answers live in online community channels.
